_about: Performance budgets for Mwakete — the single source of truth for the CI gate (performance-audit/scripts/check-budgets.js). All byte values are GZIPPED size (level 9), the way GitHub Pages serves text assets. Budgets = the measured value at the commit noted below + small headroom, NOT arbitrary limits. See PERFORMANCE_BUDGETS.md for the rationale and how to change a budget.
_headroom: ~12% on per-page total & initial-JS gzip; ~15% on individual shared assets (they grow as features land); +3 on static request counts; web fonts hard-zero.

cwv._about: Secondary gate thresholds (performance-audit/scripts/ci-cwv.js), median of repeats on headless Chromium vs a local gzip server. Ceilings sit WELL above measured lab values so normal lab noise never flaps them — they catch gross regressions only. Lab, not field.
